Class ExprToTFF

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.parsing.ExprToTFF
public class ExprToTFF extends Object

This is a NEW class alongside the existing string-based SUMOtoTFAform; it does not modify that class. When a pre-built or freshly parsed Expr tree is available, callers can use translate(com.articulate.sigma.parsing.Expr, boolean, com.articulate.sigma.KB) to skip the heavyweight string-manipulation pipeline that SUMOtoTFAform.process() performs.

Key difference from FOF (ExprToTPTP)

TFF requires every bound and free variable to carry a sort annotation: 

   FOF:  ! [V__X,V__Y] : body
   TFF:  ! [V__X : s__Dog, V__Y : $i] : body
This class infers sort annotations in a single pre-pass over the Expr tree by collecting (instance ?X Type) constraints, then propagates them through the quantifier traversal. Variables with no inferred sort receive the TFF catch-all sort $i.

Sort mapping

  • Integer (and subclasses) → $int
  • RealNumber → $real
  • RationalNumber → $rat
  • Any other SUMO class → s__ClassName
  • Unknown / unresolved → $i

Arithmetic handling

Formulas containing numeric literals or numeric-typed signatures are handled by translateArithmetic(com.articulate.sigma.parsing.Expr, boolean, com.articulate.sigma.KB), which runs an Expr-tree preprocessing pipeline mirroring the string-based preprocessing in SUMOtoTFAform.processExpr(com.articulate.sigma.parsing.Expr, boolean).

Fallback

Callers should fall back to {link com.articulate.sigma.trans.SUMOtoTFAform#process(Formula, boolean)} when translate(com.articulate.sigma.parsing.Expr, boolean, com.articulate.sigma.KB) returns null (parse failure or unsupported construct).

    • translate

      public static String translate(Expr expr, boolean query, KB kb)
      Translate an Expr tree to a TFF formula string.

      Variable sort annotations are inferred from (instance ?X Type) patterns within the formula. Variables not constrained by such patterns receive the default sort $i.

      Formulas containing numeric literals or numeric-typed signatures are routed to translateArithmetic(com.articulate.sigma.parsing.Expr, boolean, com.articulate.sigma.KB) which runs the full preprocessing pipeline. When kb is null and numeric literals are present, returns null (caller must fall back to the string-based pipeline).

      Parameters:
      expr - the formula tree (must not be null)
      query - true for query mode (free vars get ?)
      kb - knowledge base used to resolve numeric subclass sorts; may be null (falls back to $i)
      Returns:
      TFF formula string, or null if not handled here

    • translateArithmetic

      public static String translateArithmetic(Expr expr, boolean query, KB kb)
      Translate an Expr containing numeric content (literals or numeric-typed signatures) to a TFF string.

      Mirrors the preprocessing pipeline of SUMOtoTFAform.processExpr(Expr, boolean) but operates entirely on Expr trees rather than KIF strings. Steps:

      1. Substitute Pi / NumberE with their decimal values
      2. Remove (instance ?X Integer) / (instance ?X RealNumber)
      3. Replace sub-numeric instance constraints with their definitions
      4. Eliminate degenerate logical operators (fixed-point)
      5. Build variable type map from type restrictions
      6. Reject formulas with inconsistent variable types
      7. Iterative function-variable type propagation
      8. Remove remaining numeric instance assertions
      9. Final degenerate-logop cleanup
      10. Translate via SUMOtoTFAform.processRecurseExpr(com.articulate.sigma.parsing.Expr, java.lang.String)
      11. Wrap result with typed quantifier if free variables exist
      Parameters:
      expr - the formula tree (must not be null)
      query - true for query mode (free vars get ?)
      kb - knowledge base (must not be null)
      Returns:
      TFF string, "" for vacuous formulas, null on error

    • constrainFunctVarsExpr

      public static Expr constrainFunctVarsExpr(Expr expr, String parentType, Map<String,Set<String>> varmap, KB kb)
      Annotate function/predicate operator names with context-derived type suffixes and propagate variable types into varmap.

      Mirrors {link SUMOtoTFAform#constrainFunctVarsRecurse} / {link SUMOtoTFAform#constrainOp} but operates entirely on Expr trees. The key purpose is to rewrite operator atoms so that, e.g., (DivisionFn 10 2) in context (equal … 5) becomes (DivisionFn__0In1In2InFn 10 2). The type-annotated name is then read back by relationExtractSigFromName during the recursive TFF translation, giving the correct return-type encoding in the output.

      Steps for each compound node:

      1. Collect the declared KB signature for the operator.
      2. Refine with any type already encoded in the operator name (from a previous iteration) via relationExtractSigFromName.
      3. Refine further with the actual argument types.
      4. For equal-type operators: unify all positions to the most specific type.
      5. For function operators: overwrite position 0 (return type) with the most specific of the declared return type and parentType.
      6. If the refined signature differs from the KB signature, rename the operator atom with the type suffix via makePredFromArgTypes.
      7. Recurse into each child with the refined type for its position.
      Parameters:
      expr - the Expr subtree to annotate
      parentType - the type expected by the enclosing context
      varmap - mutable variable-type map (updated as a side-effect)
      kb - knowledge base
      Returns:
      a new Expr tree with operator atoms type-annotated

    • removeNumericInstanceExpr

      public static Expr removeNumericInstanceExpr(Expr expr, Map<String,Set<String>> varmap)
      Remove numeric (instance ...) assertions from the formula tree, recording the numeric types found into varmap as a side-effect.

      Mirrors SUMOtoTFAform.removeNumericInstance(String). For each (instance ?X Type) node encountered:

      • If Type is RealNumber/RationalNumber/Integer: add to varmap and remove the node.
      • If the variable already has a numeric type in varmap: remove.
      • If Type is a numeric sub-type with a known constraint: replace with the constraint expression.

      Parameters:
      expr - formula tree to process
      varmap - mutable variable-type map (updated as a side-effect)
      Returns:
      transformed Expr, or null if the node should be dropped

    • containsNumericLiteral

      private static boolean containsNumericLiteral(Expr expr)
      Returns true if expr contains any Expr.NumLiteral node.

      Formulas with numeric literals involve arithmetic functions (e.g. AbsoluteValueFn, difference) whose TFF signatures use $real/$int/$rat. Variables appearing in those functions need arithmetic sorts, but the same variables often also appear in logical predicates (e.g. s__instance) that expect $i. SUMOtoTFAform resolves this via predicate-name mangling; this class does not, so such formulas must fall back to the legacy translator.

    • containsNumericSignature

      private static boolean containsNumericSignature(Expr expr, KB kb)
      Returns true if any function or predicate in expr has a numeric sort (RealNumber, Integer, RationalNumber or subclass) in its KB signature.

      Such formulas require SUMOtoTFAform's predicate-name mangling to reconcile numeric-typed arguments with $i-typed predicates (e.g. s__MeasureFn : ($real * $i) > $i used inside s__measure(...) which expects $i).

    • containsPiOrNumberEAtom

      private static boolean containsPiOrNumberEAtom(Expr expr)
      Returns true if expr contains an Expr.Atom named "Pi" or "NumberE".

      Formulas containing these atoms (e.g. (instance Pi RealNumber)) must go through the arithmetic path so that SUMOtoTFAform.instantiateNumericConstants(com.articulate.sigma.Formula) can drop them or substitute their decimal values.

    • varSortName

      private static String varSortName(String sumoType)
      Returns the TFF sort to use as a variable type annotation.

      Always returns $i — the universal TFF individual sort that requires no separate type declaration. Named SUMO sorts (e.g. s__Dog) are only valid if a tff(..., type, s__Dog: $tType) declaration precedes the axiom. ExprToTFF does not generate those declarations (it skips SUMOtoTFAform.missingSorts()), so any sort other than the built-in $i would cause "Undeclared type constructor" prover errors. The semantic content ("X is a Dog") is preserved in the formula body via s__instance(V__X, s__Dog) regardless of the variable's declared sort.

    • seedMissingVarsToVarmap

      static void seedMissingVarsToVarmap(Expr expr, Map<String,Set<String>> varmap)
      Walk expr and ensure every Expr.Var node has an entry in varmap. Variables not already mapped receive "Entity" as their type.

      This mirrors the side-effect of SUMOtoTFAform.constrainOp() (line ~1943) which calls MapUtils.addToMap(getVarmap(), variable, parentType) for every variable encountered during the tree walk. Without this guarantee, processCompOpExpr crashes when it calls bestSpecificTerm(getVarmap().get(v)) for a variable absent from the map (returns null) and then passes that null to bestOfPair(null, best) which immediately NPEs.

    • mergeVarmapConstraint

      static void mergeVarmapConstraint(Map<String,Set<String>> varmap, Map<String,Set<String>> newTypes, KB kb)
      Merge newTypes into varmap, keeping the more specific type for each variable.

      Mirrors the logic of the private SUMOtoTFAform.constrainTypeRestriction(Map) method: for each variable, picks the new type if it is a subclass of the existing type; otherwise keeps the existing type.

    • buildQuantifiedResultArith

      static String buildQuantifiedResultArith(String body, boolean query, Map<String,Set<String>> varmap, Set<String> freeVars, KB kb)
      Build the TFF quantifier wrapper for the translated body.

      Mirrors SUMOtoTFAform.buildQuantifiedResult(Formula, String, boolean) but takes explicit parameters instead of using a Formula and a ThreadLocal.

      Parameters:
      body - already-translated TFF body string
      query - true for existential (query) mode
      varmap - variable → type-set map built during preprocessing
      freeVars - free (unquantified) variables in the preprocessed Expr
      kb - KB for sort name translation
      Returns:
      quantified TFF string, or body if there are no typed free vars
